outcome: Cord blood serum epidermal growth factor (EGF) content
cohort: 135 donors from the Emilia Romagna Cord Blood Bank
finding: Cord blood serum EGF content was significantly higher in samples from donors aged <30 years and after vaginal deliveries compared to scheduled Cesarean sections.
mod_finding: EGF content was significantly higher in cord blood serum from vaginal deliveries compared to scheduled Cesarean sections.
